scope_branches: Straight traversal from a right-turn-lane approach
source_law_text: If a highway has been designed to provide a single right lane to be used only for turning, a vehicle must: While being driven in the right turn lane, not travel through an intersection.

statutory_branch_review.activation: A highway designed to provide a single right lane used only for turning; subject is being driven in that right turn lane.
statutory_branch_review.obligation: While driven in that right turn lane, do not travel through an intersection.
statutory_branch_review.timing: Continuous lane identity and body crossing of the intersection boundary, followed by complete straight exit.
statutory_branch_review.distinct_related_clause: NRS 484B.223(4)(a) concerns purpose of right-turn-lane use; this (4)(b) clause concerns the through-intersection crossing.
